_doc: City budgets per tier, checked by `pnpm test:perf` (scripts/perf-budget.mjs) on the default open view at 2026-11-20 14:00 with all 12 areas mounted; `high-night` repeats high at 22:00, where lit windows and lamps add draws and programs. `ceiling` fails the check (regression guard, set ~10% over the 2026-11-23 measurement on main). `target` is the goal and is reported, not enforced, until a cut reaches it; then move the ceiling down. Counts and memory come from a headless Studio run and match the device; fps and A16 ready time come only from the A16 runs in docs/perf.md. Studio readyMs swings 2-4x with shader-cache state and machine load, so it is a target only; the A16 ready time is the real check.
